intent: Wrap any pressable element so activating it opens the OS file picker (or camera), without building a custom `<input type="file">`.
avoid_when: a drag-and-drop drop zone with per-file progress UI is needed (use file-upload)
a11y_contract: clones its single child and wires the native file input. The child must already be an accessible, focusable trigger (e.g. a Button); this component adds no label of its own
requires_data: a single pressable child element to act as the trigger; an onSelect handler to receive the chosen FileList
